title: Dallas Flavor and History Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Accessibility Notice Please note that Fun Texas Tours vans are not wheelchair accessible. Guests who use wheelchairs or require special accommodations must contact Fun Texas Tours in advance at 214-728-8528 to discuss possible arrangements.
Texas law mandates that children under 8 years old, unless they are taller than 4 ft 9 in, must be secured in an appropriate Child Passenger Safety seat or booster seat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the flavors and stories of Dallas on this guided 2 or 4-hour food and history tour in our comfortable, climate controlled van with a local tour guide.
